reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis ignores the fundamental immiscibility of W and Cu, so claiming a uniform solid solution or nanocrystalline microstructure will form is physically unsound; SPS/MA can refine structure but cannot overcome the thermodynamic driving force for phase separation.
reasons.testability: The proposed test compares MA+SPS against a vague 'conventional casting or sintering' baseline without specifying processing parameters, measurement conditions, or a clear falsification threshold, making it weak and incomplete.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis merely restates a well-known processing route (MA+SPS) without addressing the specific challenge of W-Cu immiscibility or proposing a novel intervention, so it offers little new guidance to a researcher.
